hero.sub: Brief Tarima once. It calls venues, chases sponsors and fills every row of your chase board — you approve, it executes.
hero.note: Free while in early access. No credit card.
app.title: Tarima
app.newProjectName: Project name, e.g. Spring hackathon sponsors
app.empty: No projects yet. Create one to start chasing.
login.title: Sign in

login.invalidCode: That code is not right. Try again.
login.expired: Your code expired. Send a new one.
board.empty: No rows yet. Import a csv or add the first row.

chase.nothingToDo: Nothing to chase: every row already advanced.
errors.offline: The board could not be reached. Retry in a moment.
